source.snippet: Rather than having a single API key for an account, allow multiple API keys that are assigned different permissions over the account. — Feature request on FOSSBilling (open-source billing platform), captured 2026-06-21.

problem_statement: Operators running billing or hosting infrastructure on platforms like FOSSBilling are forced to use a single all-or-nothing API key, creating security risks when integrating with third-party services, automation scripts, or team members who should only have partial access.
target_segment: Small hosting providers, SaaS operators, and freelancers managing client billing via self-hosted billing platforms (FOSSBilling, WHMCS alternatives).
notes: Single feature request but from a business operator context — people running FOSSBilling are operating actual hosting/billing businesses. The pain (single global API key = security risk) is well-understood in the API space and affects any operator integrating billing APIs with resellers or automation. Weak signal on its own; worth watching for recurrence across WHMCS, Blesta, or other billing forum communities before promoting.
